newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat leaves for Malta Euro-Med meeting.
newsitem.headline: Arafat leaves for Malta Euro-Med meeting.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left Cairo for Malta on Tuesday to take part in a meeting of European and Mediterranean foreign ministers, airport officials said.
Arafat is expected to use the meeting to tell the ministers that Israel's settlement policy in Arab East Jerusalem is the main reason Middle East peace talks have stopped.
The Palestinian leader met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Monday to discuss the latest troubles in the peace process.

Israeli and Palestinian ministers will meet on the sidelines of the European-Mediterranean conference, Palestinian Planning Minister Nabil Shaath said in Valetta on Tuesday. Shaath said he would meet Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy but Arafat would not be present.
It will be the first time Israelis and Palestinians have met at this level since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered work to start on a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
